result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now works as a second name for `updateLandscape`, with identical behaviour and options. It compiles with `mvn -o -pl cli compile`. I didn't run any tests or try either command, so the dispatch and the `-help` output are unchecked.

- **`Commands.java`**: I added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description, which says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. It is listed in the no-argument usage overview, using the same options as `updateLandscape`.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: the dispatch for `updateLandscape` now also accepts `analyzeLandscape`. With `-help`, each name prints its own usage (`java -jar sokrates.jar analyzeLandscape` or `... updateLandscape`) with its own description.
- **`README.md`**: it had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Commands" section. It documents `analyzeLandscape` and notes that `updateLandscape` is the older name, kept for existing scripts.
